'''Delta Squadron''', also known as '''Delta Group''', was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that fought during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], it took part in the [[Battle of Science Station Youst]] in the [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]].

That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Marvel timeline">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' (p. 121) places the events of the issues [[Star Wars (1977) 52|52]], [[Star Wars (1977) 61|61]], and [[Star Wars (1977) 69|69]] of the [[Star Wars (1977)|Marvel ''Star Wars'' comics]] in 3–3.5 ABY. Thus, all events between can be placed in 3 ABY.</ref> the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] was led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Milnn]] and served with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mils Giel]]'s [[secret armada]]. On a reconnaissance patrol, Delta Group picked up a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] from a nearby [[Uninhabited planetoid|planetoid]]. Unsure if the signal was [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] or [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] in origin, four of the squadron's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] approached to find the wreckage of an another TIE fighter, springing a Rebel trap.<ref name="SW61" />

Alliance [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] ambushed the squadron, killing Milnn's three subordinates and forcing the captain to [[Ejector seat/Legends|eject]] from his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] before it was destroyed. Milnn was captured by [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]], including [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and Captain [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]], who, with the aid of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], extracted entry codes to Giels' [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] from the [[TIE pilot]].<ref name="SW61" />

Using these codes, Skywalker impersonated Milnn as "[[Delta Leader/Legends|Delta Leader]]," with his [[Flying Bantha Squadron|squadron of Rebel TIE pilots]]&mdash;Brie, Captain [[Hanc Thorben]], and [[Alph (Rogue)|Alph]]&mdash;posing as Delta Group to [[Battle of the secret armada|infiltrate]] the secret armada.<ref name="SW61" />
